predictions.title: Error 500 al pagar el pedido
predictions.rationale: A 500 error occurs at the moment of payment in production, preventing all users from completing orders. This is a full outage of the core checkout/payment flow with no workaround.

predictions.title: checkout broken!!!
predictions.rationale: Production shows a 500 error when placing orders affecting all users since the last deploy. The payment/checkout flow is completely blocked with no workaround.

predictions.title: Order confirmation returns HTTP 500
predictions.rationale: Returns HTTP 500 when placing orders in production on all platforms. This is a full outage of the core payment flow with no workaround.

predictions.title: Cobro duplicado con tarjeta
predictions.rationale: Customers are being charged twice for the same order due to a retry mechanism issue during gateway timeouts. This is incorrect payment behavior affecting multiple customers.

predictions.title: Customers charged twice for one order
predictions.rationale: Duplicate captures on card payments due to retry logic after gateway timeouts. The system creates only one order but captures the payment twice. This is incorrect payment behavior with financial impact.

predictions.title: me cobraron 2 veces!!
predictions.rationale: Customer reports being charged twice for a single order. This is a duplicate payment issue affecting customers financially, part of the same root cause as similar reports.

predictions.title: Notificación push duplicada
predictions.rationale: Push notifications are being sent twice for each shipped order. The notifications are working but duplicated. This is a non-core notification issue affecting all users.

predictions.title: Duplicate 'order shipped' push
predictions.rationale: Duplicate push notifications sent when orders are shipped. The notification function works but sends duplicates. This is a functional issue in the notification system.

predictions.title: Botón Guardar aparece en inglés
predictions.rationale: A button label is not translated on the profile page. The function works correctly but displays English text instead of Spanish. This is a cosmetic/translation issue.

predictions.title: Untranslated 'Save' button on Spanish profile page
predictions.rationale: The Save button on the profile page is not translated when the language is set to Spanish. This is a UI/translation issue with no functional impact.

predictions.title: App crashes opening order history
predictions.rationale: The app terminates/crashes immediately when accessing order history for a specific subset of users. This is a crash defect in the profile component where order history is displayed.

predictions.title: Crash: IndexOutOfBoundsException in OrderAdapter
predictions.rationale: IndexOutOfBoundsException crash specifically in OrderAdapter when binding to RecyclerView, with 2,310 events in 24h. This is the technical root cause of the profile/order history crashes.

predictions.title: order history closes the app
predictions.rationale: Same crash issue as inc-0011/0012 but reported from a user perspective. The app closes/terminates when opening order list.

predictions.title: Imagen de producto pixelada en iPad
predictions.rationale: Product images appear pixelated/blurry on iPad because the thumbnail is loading instead of the full image. This is a UI/static asset quality issue in the catalog display.

predictions.title: fotos borrosas en tablet
predictions.rationale: Same issue as inc-0014 - product images display with poor quality on tablets (Galaxy Tab). This is a UI issue where the wrong image resolution is being served.

predictions.title: Búsqueda muy lenta en la app
predictions.rationale: Search takes 6-8 seconds on mobile app vs instant on web. Core flow is slow but works. This is a performance issue specific to the mobile app's search functionality.

predictions.title: buscar tarda muchisimo
predictions.rationale: Same issue as inc-0016 - search is very slow in the app while web is fast. Users abandon due to long loading times.

predictions.title: Latencia alta en /search desde móvil
predictions.rationale: Technical analysis confirms search endpoint latency issue: mobile app using different endpoint with 7.8s p95 latency vs 300ms for web. Root cause is the app not using the new index.

predictions.title: Password reset email not arriving for Hotmail users
predictions.rationale: Password reset emails are not being delivered to specific email providers (Hotmail/Outlook) while Gmail works. This is a notifications/delivery issue affecting a subset of users in the auth flow.

predictions.title: No reset email (outlook)
predictions.rationale: Same as inc-0019 - user cannot receive password reset email via Outlook. Not in spam, indicating delivery failure. Affects auth flow for a specific user segment.

predictions.title: Direcciones guardadas se duplican al editar
predictions.rationale: When a user edits a saved address, instead of updating it the system creates a duplicate. This is a data integrity issue where the same address appears multiple times. The problem is in the profile/address management system.

predictions.title: Se repiten mis direcciones
predictions.rationale: This is the same duplicate address bug as inc-0021 - after editing an address, multiple copies exist. It's a data integrity issue affecting user profiles.

predictions.title: Partner reports missing webhooks
predictions.rationale: Partner reports that order.created webhooks are not being delivered. The webhook delivery log is empty, indicating the webhook system is not generating or sending notifications. This is the external-facing symptoms of a failed webhook system.

predictions.title: Webhook delivery queue empty for order events
predictions.rationale: The webhook dispatcher shows zero deliveries for order.created events since deployment, but other event types work. This confirms the issue is specifically in the webhook/API layer that handles order events.

predictions.title: Pantalla en blanco en el paso de envío
predictions.rationale: A TypeError causes a blank screen at the shipping step on all platforms, completely blocking checkout. The error references 'zones' which is part of delivery options calculation. This is a critical showstopper for all purchases across web and app.

predictions.title: Historial de pedidos vacío después de la migración
predictions.rationale: After database migration, order history data is missing for thousands of users. Support cannot see the orders either, indicating the data is now inaccessible. This is a data loss issue affecting order records.

predictions.title: Precio en la app distinto al de la web
predictions.rationale: Product prices displayed in the app differ from the web, showing old/stale prices. The catalog pricing system is not syncing correctly between platforms, leading to customer confusion even though checkout uses the correct price.

predictions.title: No llega el código de verificación por SMS
predictions.rationale: Two-factor authentication SMS codes are not being delivered, but users have a workaround via email. This is a partial outage in the notification system affecting a subset of users (those with MFA enabled).

predictions.title: No acepta tarjetas American Express
predictions.rationale: American Express cards are consistently rejected while Visa and Mastercard work. This is a payment card validation or processing issue that blocks a subset of users from completing purchases.

predictions.title: El carrito se vacía al cerrar sesión
predictions.rationale: The cart clears when logging out and back in for all users. This suggests cart data is tied to session rather than persisting to the user account, or session persistence is broken in the cart component.

predictions.title: No se pueden marcar pedidos como enviados
predictions.rationale: The 'Mark as shipped' button in the admin interface is broken, forcing warehouse staff to use a manual API workaround. This is a broken core admin function affecting order processing workflow.

predictions.title: No se ve la tabla de tallas en móvil
predictions.rationale: The size chart table is not displaying on mobile product pages, though it works on desktop. This is a layout/display issue specific to mobile view.

predictions.title: Imágenes de productos tardan mucho en 3G
predictions.rationale: Product images are loading too slowly on 3G connections, taking over 10 seconds. This is a performance/speed issue affecting user experience.

predictions.title: Reporte de ventas no incluye pedidos con cupón
predictions.rationale: The monthly sales report in admin is excluding orders that used coupons, causing financial totals to be incorrect. This is a data accuracy issue.

predictions.title: Buscar clientes en el admin tarda 15 segundos
predictions.rationale: Customer search by email in the admin is taking 15 seconds. This is a performance/speed issue affecting admin workflow.

predictions.title: El cupón de primera compra se puede usar varias veces
predictions.rationale: The first-purchase-only coupon (BIENVENIDA) can be used multiple times instead of being restricted to the first order. This is a functional error in coupon validation logic.

predictions.title: Mensaje de error del login en inglés
predictions.rationale: The login error message appears in English when the app is set to Spanish. This is a translation/text issue.

predictions.title: Logo estirado en los correos
predictions.rationale: The logo appears stretched in emails opened in Outlook. This is a layout/styling issue specific to email rendering.

predictions.title: Texto 'Direccion de envio' sin acentos
predictions.rationale: The checkout page shows 'Direccion de envio' without proper accents ('Dirección de envío'). This is a copy/spelling issue.

predictions.title: Montos alineados a la izquierda en tablas del admin
predictions.rationale: Amounts in admin tables are left-aligned instead of right-aligned, making comparison difficult. This is a layout/styling usability issue.

predictions.title: Session token in URL leaks to analytics
predictions.rationale: Session tokens leaking to third-party analytics creates a security vulnerability where vendor employees could hijack user sessions. This is a security breach with no workaround.

predictions.title: User sees another customer's cart
predictions.rationale: Users seeing each other's cart items and addresses due to CDN caching is a data exposure issue. This is a security problem where sensitive data crosses user boundaries, though it only affects users behind the same corporate proxy.

predictions.title: Search shows products that can't ship to the user's region
predictions.rationale: Search is returning products that users cannot actually purchase due to regional restrictions. This is a functional issue where search isn't respecting region filters, causing frustration at checkout for many Mexican users.

predictions.title: iOS app crashes on payment step with saved card
predictions.rationale: The iOS app crashes specifically when using saved cards during payment. This is a crash bug in the payment flow that prevents completion with saved payment methods.

predictions.title: Can't change account email
predictions.rationale: The email update appears to save but doesn't actually persist. This is a functional bug where profile updates aren't being stored, affecting a single user's ability to change their contact info.

predictions.title: Admin order list shows times in UTC
predictions.rationale: Order times display in UTC instead of local time in the admin panel. This is a UI/timing display issue that causes confusion but doesn't block functionality.

predictions.title: Order cancellation email not sent
predictions.rationale: Cancellation emails are not being sent to customers after support cancels an order. The order was cancelled successfully but the notification system failed to send the email.

predictions.title: API returns 200 with empty body for unknown product
predictions.rationale: The API returns HTTP 200 with an empty body instead of 404 for unknown products. This is incorrect behavior that breaks partner integrations that rely on proper error codes.

predictions.title: Autocomplete lags on older iPhones
predictions.rationale: Search autocomplete has significant lag on older devices. This is a performance issue where the search functionality works but is too slow, degrading user experience on iPhone 11 and older.

predictions.title: Push shows price in USD instead of MXN
predictions.rationale: Push notifications show incorrect currency labels (USD instead of MXN). This is a display/UI issue in notifications - the amounts are correct but mislabeled, causing confusion but not blocking functionality.

predictions.title: Long product titles truncated with no tooltip
predictions.rationale: This is a cosmetic UI issue where information is not fully visible but the user can still click to view the product details. It doesn't block functionality.

predictions.title: Avatar not round on Firefox
predictions.rationale: Visual styling issue specific to Firefox browser. The avatar still works functionally, it's just not rendered as round.

predictions.title: Admin sidebar icon misaligned
predictions.rationale: Pixel-level alignment issue in the admin interface. Purely cosmetic and doesn't affect functionality.

predictions.title: Typo 'Adress' in shipping form
predictions.rationale: Minor text/copy error - a typo in the form label. The form still works correctly.

predictions.title: API docs example uses an old field name
predictions.rationale: Documentation error that could cause integration issues for developers. The API itself works correctly, but the docs are misleading.

predictions.title: Card brand logos have different sizes
predictions.rationale: Visual inconsistency in logo sizing. The payment functionality works correctly, just the logos are different sizes.

predictions.title: Read-only staff account can export customer data
predictions.rationale: Authorization failure allowing unauthorized data export. Read-only accounts should not be able to export sensitive customer data including PII.

predictions.title: Category page takes over ten seconds to load
predictions.rationale: Significant initial load time issue (11-14 seconds) for category pages. Once loaded it's fast, but the first visit delay is substantial for users.

predictions.title: Expired saved card is accepted until final payment
predictions.rationale: The payment flow accepts an expired card at selection time and only fails at the final step. This is a functional validation issue in the checkout flow that causes poor UX.

predictions.title: Unread notification badge does not clear immediately
predictions.rationale: UI state synchronization issue where the notification badge doesn't update until page refresh. Functional issue where the notification system doesn't behave as expected.
